item.title: Melania Trump will preside over a UN Security Council meeting in a first for a first lady
item.description: The United States takes over the rotating presidency of the 15-member council for March.

item.title: Cuba says 8 World Baseball Classic delegation members denied US visas
item.description: Cuba is set to play against Puerto Rico, Colombia, Panama and Canada in San Juan.

item.title: Brendan Riley’s Solano Chronicles: The days of racial redlining in Vallejo
item.description: The whites-only wording in the old covenants and homeowner association bylaws now may be unenforceable, but Rothstein and other experts say they contributed to a longstanding wealth gap that hurt people of color.

item.title: NTSB chair slams House aviation bill as ‘watered-down’ after 67 deaths near Washington
item.description: Jennifer Homendy said the House bill’s “watered-down” requirements wouldn’t do enough to prevent a tragedy.

item.title: Republican voter ID bill stalls in Senate despite Trump demands
item.description: Thune says he supports the legislation and his conference is discussing how to pass it.

item.title: Yankees set to retire CC Sabathia’s number
item.description: The New York Yankees announced on Tuesday that Sabathia's former number of 52 with the team will be retired on Sept. 26 in a game against the Baltimore Orioles. A plaque in his honor is also set to be dedicated prior to the game that day.

item.title: Danette Mitchell: The life and times of the Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: Rev. Jackson left lessons we can learn from, especially for young people, so that they feel inspired and prepared to carry the torch forward, addressing civil rights, economic justice, environmental, and health issues.

item.title: Vallejo man arrested, arraigned on child sexual abuse materials charges
item.description: A Vallejo man was arrested earlier this month on felony charges related to child sexual abuse material following a search of his home, the Solano County Sheriff’s Office said. Justin Luna, 31, was taken into custody without incident. He was booked into the Solano County Jail on felony charges of possession of child pornography and distribution of child pornography. item.title: Preliminary hearing date set in Vallejo slaying
item.description: A 41-year-old Vallejo man accused of killing a woman, dismembering her body, and hiding the remains in his attic had a preliminary hearing date set for June during a brief court in Solano County Superior Court this week. Douglas Irwin Shaw will have a two-day preliminary hearing beginning at 1:30 p.m. on June 3 in the Fairfield courtroom of Judge John B. Ellis. item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Maduro's attorney says the U.S. government violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds.
